newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian soybean prices down on limited buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian soybean prices down on limited buying.

text.p: Indian soybean prices on Friday fell by 100-150 rupees per tonne on limited buying from processing plants, dealers said.
Soyoil prices eased on increased selling from plants and refineries. Soyoil solvent fell by 200 rupees and soyoil refined was down by 300 rupees per tonne.

Soymeal prices decreased as export demand was limited and buyers were looking for lower prices. Soymeal yellow was $270-$271 in export. Rapeseed extraction was $134 per tonne in export. Rapeseed extraction was 4,550 rupees FOR Bedi Bunder and 4,500 rupees to 4,525 FOR Bhavnagar.
